3.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
3.notes:
You always have certain spells prepared according to the Oath of Devotion Spells table.

3rd: Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith
5th: Aid, Zone of Truth
9th: Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic
13th: Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith
17th: Commune, Flame Strike

3.name: Sacred Weapon
3.notes:
When you take the Attack action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue a melee weapon you hold with positive energy for 10 minutes or until you use this feature again.

You add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with that weapon, and each hit deals its normal damage type or Radiant damage.

The weapon emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

You may end this effect early (no action required). The effect ends if you stop carrying the weapon.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.notes: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to the Charmed condition. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, the condition has no effect while they remain within it.

15.name: Smite of Protection
15.notes: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies in your Aura of Protection gain Half Cover. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.notes:
As a Bonus Action, imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). Usable once per Long Rest or restored by expending a level 5 spell slot.

Holy Ward. You have Advantage on saving throws forced by Fiends or Undead.

Radiant Damage. Enemies starting their turn in the aura take Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

Sunlight. The aura sheds Bright Light that counts as sunlight.
